init.title: MaxSensor TPMS – Settings
init.description: Sensor IDs are 5 characters (as shown in the Multi Wheel app); separate multiple IDs with commas.

data.min_rssi: Minimum signal strength for new sensors (dBm, empty = off)

data_description.min_rssi: Keeps vehicles in the neighborhood out, e.g. -80. Applies to new sensors only.
data_description.manual_ids: Creates devices before the sensor transmits for the first time.
